    Prepare Embedded Standard Setting input data

    ess_data.Rd

    Builds the input for [emstans()] from data frames or files, in any column layout. Ratings and items are required; setup information (level labels, SD, EC) can come from a setup table, from arguments, or both, with arguments taking precedence.

    Usage

    ess_data(
  ratings,
  items,
  setup = NULL,
  examinees = NULL,
  levels = NULL,
  sd = NULL,
  ec = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  quiet = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    ratings

    Panelists' item alignments: a data frame or a path to a `.csv` file. One row per panelist, item and round.

    items

    Item information, including the location column(s) such as `RP67`: a data frame or a path to a `.csv` file.

    setup

    Optional setup table (one row per grade), a data frame or a path to a `.csv` file. Its `Level Options` column lists the level labels from lowest to highest, separated by commas.

    examinees

    Optional score frequencies for impact data: a data frame or a path to a `.csv` file in long format, one row per grade and score, with three columns: grade (`GCA` or `Grade`), `Score` (on the same scale as the item locations) and `Freq` (number of examinees with that score). Wide tables with repeated Score/Freq/Grade blocks side by side are not accepted.

    levels

    Level labels from lowest to highest. A character vector applies to every grade; a named list gives labels per grade, for example `list(R1 = c("E", "M", "L"), R2 = c("B", "P", "A"))`. Overrides the setup table.

    sd, ec

    Scaling SD and essential-consistency threshold. A single number applies to every grade; a named vector gives values per grade. Override the setup table. Defaults are SD = 1 and EC = 0.

    columns

    Optional column mapping for tables whose column names differ from the defaults. A named list per table, each a named list or vector of input column names or positions, for example `list(ratings = list(item_id = "ItemID", level = 8))`. The standard names are: ratings `grade`, `round`, `table`, `panelist`, `item_id`, `level`; items `grade`, `item_id`, `domain`, `order`; setup `grade`, `levels`, `sd`, `ec`; examinees `grade`, `score`, `freq`.

    quiet

    If `FALSE`, report the column mapping that was used.

    Value

    An object of class `"ess_data"`.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
d <- ess_data(
  ratings = "ratings.csv",
  items   = "items.csv",
  levels  = c("Basic", "Intermediate", "Advanced"),
  columns = list(ratings = list(panelist = "Rater", level = "Judgment"))
)
res <- emstans(data = d, loc = "RP67")
} # }
